## Key Context Used in Plan
- Julie's Archaeologist background + low INT (6) = she has proficiency-based knowledge of ancient sites but isn't traditionally smart
- Julie was already cursed once (Session 6) — callback opportunity
- Diego's swordsman legacy connects thematically to Julie's fighter identity
- Party is traveling Ardenville → Silverleaf Lands — road between them is natural location for a ruin discovery
- Ardenville has both a smithy (Eldric Steelshaper) and magic shop (Garrick Lightfinger) for planting seeds
- Alaric Emberfell has existing relationship with Julie — natural messenger for weapon rumors
- Julie currently has a +1 Greatsword and Corpse Slayer Flamberge — a +2 sword would be a meaningful upgrade
- WIS 11 makes WIS saves against curse effects a coin flip — dramatic but not guaranteed failure
